capabilities.definition: Establish and verify identities while resisting authentication misuse.
capabilities.name: Identity and authentication protection
capabilities.security_objective: Only authenticated and authorized identities gain access.

capabilities.definition: Protect reusable secrets and credential derivatives throughout their lifecycle.
capabilities.name: Credential protection
capabilities.security_objective: Credential material remains unavailable to unauthorized actors.

capabilities.definition: Mediate transitions into elevated execution contexts.
capabilities.name: Privileged execution control
capabilities.security_objective: Privileged actions require an enforced authorization boundary.

capabilities.definition: Restrict network paths crossing a protected system boundary.
capabilities.name: Network boundary protection
capabilities.security_objective: Only intended traffic reaches protected network services.

capabilities.definition: Protect administrative access through remote-management channels.
capabilities.name: Secure remote management
capabilities.security_objective: Remote administration is authenticated, authorized, and transport protected.

capabilities.definition: Control whether executable content may run.
capabilities.name: Application and code execution control
capabilities.security_objective: Only trusted and authorized code executes.

capabilities.definition: Prevent, contain, and respond to malicious software behavior.
capabilities.name: Malware prevention and response
capabilities.security_objective: Malicious behavior is blocked or contained before material impact.

capabilities.definition: Provide confidentiality, integrity, and peer authenticity through cryptographic mechanisms.
capabilities.name: Cryptographic and transport protection
capabilities.security_objective: Information is protected in transit and at cryptographic trust boundaries.

capabilities.definition: Preserve visibility and evidence for detecting and investigating security events.
capabilities.name: Security monitoring and investigation
capabilities.security_objective: Security-relevant activity is observable and attributable.

capabilities.definition: Protect data against unauthorized disclosure, alteration, and loss.
capabilities.name: Data protection
capabilities.security_objective: Stored and processed data retains confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

migration_map.notes: The legacy domain-profile set resolves to the generic host-firewall boundary; profile remains evaluation context.
Legacy SMB effects become normative session-security mappings.
Signing and encryption remain complementary effects.
Authentication and session effects remain distinct.
Remote-management transport and credential effects are retained.
Remote desktop is conditional when deployed.
Core prevention effects remain separate from scan tuning.
Credential and elevation effects share one evaluated boundary set.
Semantic mapping for reusable password-authentication-strength recommendations.
Semantic mapping for external, consumer, and peer online-identity trust restrictions.
Semantic mapping for rejection of Basic or plaintext authentication.
